description: Where the final value of $E is not empty, the condition uses $x and $y, which no alternative has together, so it applies to no alternative. The loader reports it at the definition (engine §2, §9).
grammar:
%const $E B ∖ B
%rule text $x(A) | $y(C)
%conditions tags($x) ∪ ($E ∩ tags($y)) ≠ ∅
%redefine-const $E B
